2116503158424023398.en_summary: $GOOGL should consider spinning off Google Cloud, which could be worth nearly $1.5T on its own at 12x revenue given ~$123B annual run rate, doubling revenue, 36% margins and $561B backlog. $ORCL, Anthropic and OpenAI already using Google's TPUs; standalone Cloud could be a more neutral supplier.
2116503158424023398.zh_summary: GOOGL應考慮分拆Google Cloud，以約1230億美元年化收入、收入翻倍、36%利潤率及5610億美元積壓訂單計算，按12倍收入估值可達近1.5萬億美元。ORCL、Anthropic及OpenAI已使用Google的TPU；獨立雲業務可成為更中立的供應商。

ticker_notes.GOOGL: Cloud spin-off potential ~$1.5T at 12x revenue with strong backlog and margins

2116502202315350191.en_summary: Binance lost about $6.3B in Thursday's hack, largest crypto theft on record, ~4x Bybit's $1.5B in Feb 2025. Drain started 4:05 PM ET Oct 29, most left in 20 minutes across 10 chains. Binance set aside $6.34B to cover users ($5B already in stolen tokens). ~$3B frozen on-chain mostly $USDT/$USDC. Attacker holds 18,270 $BTC. Attributed to North Korean TraderTraitor. Withdrawals restart targeting early Sunday, PoR Monday.
2116502202315350191.zh_summary: 幣安在周四黑客事件中損失約63億美元，為史上最大加密貨幣盜竊案，約為2025年2月Bybit 15億美元的4倍。資金於10月29日美東時間下午4:05開始流出，大部分在20分鐘內跨10條鏈轉出。幣安預留63.4億美元覆蓋用戶（其中50億已為被盜代幣）。約30億美元鏈上凍結，主要為USDT/USDC。攻擊者持有18270枚BTC。歸因於朝鮮TraderTraitor。提現計劃周日初恢復，周一公布儲備證明。

2116491912404459961.en_summary: $RKLB now has Neutron’s second stage and thrust module at LC-3, allowing launch pad testing to proceed before Stage 1 arrives. Important as Neutron lacks traditional strongback, early testing of connection may help avoid further delays.
2116491912404459961.zh_summary: RKLB的Neutron第二級及推力模組已抵達LC-3，發射台測試可在第一級抵達前推進。因Neutron未使用傳統強背架，提早測試連接有助避免進一步延遲。

ticker_notes.RKLB: Neutron progress at LC-3 reduces delay risk

2116488603887104095.en_summary: On tariffs, Milton Friedman said: "We call a tariff a protective measure. It does protect. It protects the consumer very well against one thing. It protects the consumer against low prices." Donald Trump, the TARIFF MAN, should take a listen.
2116488603887104095.zh_summary: 關於關稅，Milton Friedman說：「我們稱關稅為保護措施。它確實保護。它很好地保護消費者免受一件事：低價格。」關稅人Donald Trump應該聽聽。
